data.one_liner: Cross-platform 3D rendering plugin for Flutter using the Filament PBR engine.
data.what_it_does: Provides 3D rendering capabilities in Flutter using the Thermion toolkit and Filament PBR engine. Supports loading glTF assets, textures, camera and entity manipulation, skinning, and morph animations across mobile, desktop, and web platforms.
use_when: You need high-performance 3D rendering or glTF model display in your Flutter application.
You are building a 3D-heavy app or game requiring PBR materials and cross-platform desktop/mobile/web support.
avoid_when: You only need simple 2D UI animations or standard UI components.
You want a pure Dart 3D engine without native C++/binary compilation dependencies.
strengths: Cross-platform support including iOS, macOS, Android, Windows, Linux, and Web/WASM.
Powered by the high-performance Google Filament PBR rendering engine.
Supports advanced features like skinning, morph animations, and runtime material compilation.
weaknesses: Requires downloading static native binaries via the Dart native-assets build system on first build, which can take time.
Web builds require specific WASM files and setup configurations.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling native assets (`flutter config --enable-native-assets`), and first-time builds download large static binaries from Cloudflare. Web builds need additional configuration files.
data.minimal_example:
ViewerWidget(
  assetPath: "assets/cube.glb",
  skyboxPath: "assets/default_env_skybox.ktx",
  iblPath: "assets/default_env_ibl.ktx",
  transformToUnitCube: true,
  initialCameraPosition: Vector3(0, 0, 6),
  background: Colors.blue,
  manipulatorType: ManipulatorType.ORBIT,
)
